kjv: the city shall be accursed ... to the LORD
mine: shall be devoted to Yahweh for destruction
note: Cherem is the ban: something irrevocably given over to God, usually by destruction; "accursed" suggests a curse or magical taint rather than a dedication to Yahweh (same issue with "accursed thing" in 6:18 and ch. 7).

kjv: lest ye (Israel) make [yourselves] accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing
mine: lest you (Israel) devote them to destruction and then take some of the devoted things
note: Pen-tacharimu "lest you put under the ban" has no reflexive object; KJV supplies "yourselves", whereas the sense is devoting the city and then taking from it (the Septuagint reads "lest you covet", tachmedu).

kjv: he (the man who rebuilds Jericho) shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn
mine: At the cost of his firstborn he (the man who rebuilds Jericho) shall lay its foundation
note: The preposition be- here is the beth of price: the builder will lose his eldest and youngest sons (fulfilled in 1 Kgs 16:34); KJV's literal "in" obscures this.
